title: MorphkitDictionary
description: The Morphkit genetic dictionary — trait data consumed by the morphkit engine.

lastUpdated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change to this file, e.g. "2026-05-28T00:00:00Z".

loci.description: Map of locusId → LocusDefinition. Keys are snake_case locus identifiers.

combos.description: Named market combos that require specific allele pairings across one or more loci.

lethalCombos.description: Genotypes that are embryonically lethal. The engine sets isLethal: true for any matching outcome.

defectCombos.description: Combination-triggered congenital (non-lethal) defects, e.g. Bug Eyes or Duckbilling. The engine adds the labels to congenitalWarnings for any matching outcome.

epistasisRules.description: Epistatic visual-masking overrides (e.g. BEL solid-white, Black Head Spider near-normal). When a rule's conditions all hold, the named visuals are suppressed and the rule's label is emitted instead. Only phenotypeNames is affected — genotype and congenital warnings are untouched.

polygenicGroups.description: Diagnostic-mode polygenic gates (e.g. Desert Ghost = dg_a/dg_b/dg_c). Used only when calculationMode is 'diagnostic'; the group is visual solely when its causalLocus is homozygous-mutant.

polygenicTags.description: Valid polygenic trait labels (e.g. Jungle, Black Back). Free-form; the engine does not validate these against loci.

id.description: Unique identifier within this locus, snake_case. Must match its parent map key.

name.description: Human-readable display name, e.g. "Clown" or "Banana / Coral Glow".

defects.description: Congenital or neurological defect labels associated with this allele (even in the heterozygous state).

superDefects.description: Defect labels that fire only in the homozygous (super) state, e.g. Super Sable wobble.

aliases.description: Alternative names or abbreviations used in the community, e.g. ["BP", "Blk Past"].

shortNames.description: Very short labels for tub tags or printing shortcuts, e.g. ["Past"].

indistinctFrom.description: IDs of other alleles at THIS SAME locus that are visually indistinguishable from this one in the single-gene state.

id.description: Must match its parent map key.

isSexLinked.description: True for sex-linked loci (e.g. Banana / Coral Glow). The engine abandons independent assortment for these.

alleles.description: Map of alleleId → AlleleDefinition. Must always include a "normal" allele.

marketName.description: The registered market name for this combination, e.g. "Freeway".

aliases.description: Alternative names for this combo used in the community.

shortNames.description: Very short labels for tub tags or printing shortcuts.

requiredGenotype.description: Map of locusId → [alleleId, alleleId]. All listed locus conditions must match for the combo to trigger.

triggerGenotype.description: Map of locusId → [alleleId, alleleId]. All listed locus conditions must match for lethality to be flagged.
Map of locusId → [alleleId, alleleId]. All listed conditions must match for the defect to be flagged.

defects.description: Congenital defect labels to flag, e.g. ["Bug Eyes"].

state.description: 'present' matches ≥1 copy of `allele` (or any mutant if omitted); 'homozygous' matches when both alleles are non-normal (super/compound).

allele.description: Optional specific allele the condition is restricted to.

conditions.description: All conditions must hold for the rule to fire.

suppressLoci.description: Loci whose visual names are removed when the rule fires. Defaults to the condition loci.

suppressAll.description: When true, removes ALL visual names (a solid-white BEL masks everything).

label.description: The phenotype emitted in place of the masked traits.

loci.description: The diagnostic causal loci that make up the group, e.g. ["dg_a", "dg_b", "dg_c"].

causalLocus.description: The locus that gates the visual: the group is visual only when this locus is homozygous-mutant. Must appear in loci.

visualLabel.description: Phenotype emitted when the gate opens, e.g. "Visual Desert Ghost".
